analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($122.33) vs SMA5/20/50 ($117.88/$114.73/$113.22): short/mid-term trend above moving averages confirmed.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($114.59/$115.14): indicates strong mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (86.5%) + current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (58.9→72.5): entering overbought territory, strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.3476→0.6965): improving, indicating bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper band $119.74): breaking above upper band, indicating bullish expansion phase.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($118.90): support level based on Pivot S1.
· Swing resistance ($123.63): breaking above recent high suggests further upside.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): confirms continuation of recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.03x): increased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): enter on break of $123.63, stop loss on break of $118.90.
